data.summary: The reviews present a contradictory but authentic-seeming picture. The company appears competent for one-off repairs/supply sales (many positive reviews) but severely unreliable for ongoing weekly pool maintenance/service contracts (consistent, detailed complaints). The low ratings on Angi/Houzz align with the serious service complaints found on Google. This suggests a real operational problem in their service department, not fake reviews.
fake_signals: Some positive reviews are generic and lack specific project details
A few positive reviews mention the same staff member ('JoAnn/Joanne') repeatedly, which could indicate genuine loyalty or potential astroturfing
Low review volume on non-Google platforms makes patterns harder to assess
authentic_signals: Negative reviews contain highly specific complaints (staining, broken Polaris, leaking skimmer, exploded chlorinator) with timelines and consequences
Positive reviews also contain specific scenarios (chemical startup for new pool, freeze preparation advice, filter replacement)
Writing styles and emotional tones vary significantly between reviews, indicating individual customers
Complaints show a clear, repeated pattern of service failures, especially for ongoing maintenance contracts
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating discrepancy between Google (4.1) and Angi (3.1)/Houzz (1.0). Google reviews show a mix of strong praise and serious complaints, while other platforms have very low ratings with minimal reviews, suggesting potential sampling bias or different service types.

Stay away unless you want to throw away money for services not rendered.

reviews.text: I’ve bought chemicals and other pool equipments in the past, dealt with younger lady who was very pleasant and helpful.  I’d go here over leslie’s hands down.  5 years later,  Came back looking for a part as one of my airbnb pools needed a part replacement.  This older lady with glasses was not pleasant and acted like I was bothering her.  Hope shes not the owner because if she is — I’d suggest running a different business, it shows you’re not loving servicing people.  Sorry to bother you, will do you a favor and  won’t be coming back.
reviews.author: T D III

reviews.text: My pool has been turning yellow for three weeks. I assumed that the guys who are paid to clean and put chemicals in my pool would take care of it. When they did not, I called on Tuesday to make sure that was taken care of this week as my pool is cleaned later in the week. I was assured that it would be taken care of this week. It was not. I spent my one week of vacation unable to get in my pool because it’s now green. This company allowed my pool to turn green twice last summer. This time though I specifically called and asked for them to take care of the yellow algae. I was assured my file was pulled and that it would be taken care of. Apparently the full service does not include the pool guys looking at the pool and acknowledging that something is wrong when the pool water is yellow. I tried to call now even though they’re closed to leave a message and the mailbox is full. So my guess is that I’m not the only one with these issues.  Apparently the full service does not include the pool guys looking at the pool and acknowledging that something is wrong when the pool water is yellow. Ridiculously poor service.
reviews.author: Randi Cooper

reviews.text: I had them do my weekly pool service (used them for 6+ months) and in that time one of their guys cranked the lid down on the chlorinator to much or over filled it so it built up to much pressure (before or after the previous employee quite I dont know). When the next guy came and went to crank it off it wouldn't bunge. Another guy came out and it exploded on him. He stated it was over filled which in this case was one of the employees who did it. I agreed to pay for the replacement since the price was basically the same as online, but was not explained I would be 115 dollars in labor to install it. If you are familiar with a chlorinator it is 2 tubes that are plugged into it. One slides on with a clamp and another on the flow valve at the top. I could and would have done this if I was told it would cost me 115 dollars for such an easy install. Would not recommend them for service or maintance personally. Shop around is my recommendation.
reviews.author: Derek Coleman

reviews.text: Awful!!  Don’t use these people.  They replaced my skimmer and it leaks.  I lose hundreds of gallons every few days.  They give excuses and won’t make a permanent fix.  I will now have to spend hundreds (possibly thousands) with another company to fix.  Small claims court is next for them.

reviews.text: John Ann was very helpful in getting my warranty repair with Liberty Home Gaurd approved.  Very nice to work with and I highly recommend using Year Round Pools.

reviews.text: I called Year Round Pool and Spa to fix my pool pump.  They kept pushing my appointment back, without notifying me.  I would call each day asking if they made it by the house and they would say, oh it will be tomorrow.  This happened three times.  I finally cancelled my appointment with them and went with another company.  I found it very rude not to at least notify your customer about scheduling changes.  I had to reach out to find out why they weren't coming.  Very unprofessional.
reviews.author: Miriam Atwood

reviews.text: Lazy lazy lazy workers. If you want to pay $200 a month for someone to spend 8 minutes each time they are here to only brush your top step, and toss some chemicals in, they’re  your company.
